crop.notes: The clipping includes a baths advertisement and an 'Indian Delegation' item above the Allen item 'McCoole and Allen', which is complete.

ocr.notes: The Allen item is mostly readable but has errors (e.g. 'pe ag', 'Aljien's esioon', 'Die 3 oL'). The sum reads $800 in the transcript; the image is faint and could be $300 or $800.

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that the last of the stakes for the McCoole-Allen prize fight was put up at Tom Allen's saloon, and that Allen looked in fine condition and would go into training at once.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'Daily Democrat, Saturday Morning, May 8, 1869'. This is before the 1875 merger, so it is not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: The last of the stakes for the prize fight between Mike McCoole and Tom Allen was put up at Allen's saloon in St. Louis; McCoole was not present

notes: Also mentions that Dublin Tricks attended and that Charley Gallagher was expected but sick in bed.
